text:
Alex M: FYI raised by customer (ACME Health) — their ISO auditor says missing entries for a 2-hour window in our audit logs and they're seeing intermittent 401s on /v1/generate.
Priya S: Can you paste the exact timestamps and any correlation ids? auditor is asking for evidence that KMS operations were logged and that retention policy is applied. :thinking_face:
Alex M: Provided in the ticket: failures between 2026-03-10T14:02Z -> 2026-03-10T16:10Z. sample request id: req_0a7f9c. Customer says they saw 401 then a successful retry ~30s later.
Rob L: Looking at control-plane logs now. There was a degraded key rotation job around 14:05 UTC that retried against the KMS proxy. Might be related.
Jules R: Also saw elevated latency on auth service around that window — spike to 2.1s for token validation. Could cause client timeouts that surface as 401 depending on client retry logic.
Alex M: Customer included curl repro:

```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# response: HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized\n```

Alex M: They say same token works after ~30s.
Priya S: For ISO evidence we need: 1) audit log entries for cryptographic key access (encrypt/decrypt/rotate) for the interval, 2) proof of retention (where the logs are stored, retention policy id), 3) any HSM/KMS error events.
Marta V: I'll pull the retention policy mapping doc (ISO-27001 control mapping) and link it here. Our retention policy id is "retention_v2_prod" and audit logs are exported to GCS bucket `gs://redwood-audit-prod/iso`.
audit-bot: Automated note: export-job-audit-logs -> succeeded 2026-03-10T17:00Z (job_id: exp-20260310-17).
Rob L: I can see KMS proxy retries around 14:04:53 -> 14:06:10 UTC. Here are lines from the proxy:

```
[2026-03-10T14:04:53Z] WARN keystore: connection timeout to kms-primary (retry=1)
[2026-03-10T14:05:12Z] ERROR keystore: HSM response delayed, fallback to soft-kms (trace=req_0a7f9c)
[2026-03-10T14:05:45Z] INFO keystore: key rotation completed (rotation_id=rot-20260310-2)
```

Jules R: Auth spike corresponds:
```
[2026-03-10T14:05:10Z] auth: token-validate latency=2103ms (p95)
[2026-03-10T14:05:40Z] auth: token-validate latency=180ms (p95)
```

Priya S: Good correlation. For the ISO auditor we need a narrative: timeline of events, affected systems, log extracts showing KMS/HSM access, and a statement that retention policy was not violated (logs were exported and retained). Also any mitigating controls (e.g., automatic fallback to soft-kms) must be documented as a design decision and risk acceptance if applicable.
Alex M: Customer asking for a signed attestation that the rotation and fallback were within our allowed operational procedures. Can legal/security provide wording?
Marta V: I'll draft an attestation and ping Security.
Priya S: Action items: Rob to export a filtered log bundle (keystore + auth + export-job) for 2026-03-10T13:55Z -> 2026-03-10T16:30Z; include trace ids. Jules to prepare latency graphs and SLO data for that window. Marta to attach retention policy and control mapping doc (include control IDs: A.12.4.1, A.12.7.1 substitution mapping). Alex to coordinate with customer and request auditor contact if they want direct Q&A.
Rob L: I can produce the bundle — will redact internal IPs. Will upload to secure share and post link here when ready. ETA 90m.
Jules R: I'll generate a quick grafana snapshot + raw metrics export. ETA 45m.
Marta V: Drafting attestation now. Will mark it 'confidential' until legal reviews.
Alex M: Customer confirmed they'd accept our attestation + log bundle as evidence but might request cross-check with HSM vendor if auditor insists.
Priya S: Note for risk register: fallback to soft-kms is an escalation path; doc the accepted risk and any follow-ups (improve KMS retries, alerting for HSM latency). I'll open a quick RFC to add stricter alert thresholds.
Rob L: Upload done: https://internal-files.redwood.ai/s/secure/iso-evidence/1998864000-bundle.tar.gz (access: security+support).
Marta V: Attestation draft: "On 2026-03-10 at 14:05 UTC, a temporary HSM latency event caused keystore proxy to fallback to software-backed keys for <2 minutes. Key rotation completed successfully. Audit logs for the interval were exported and are retained under retention_v2_prod. No unauthorized key material exposure occurred." Will send to legal.
Alex M: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer and keep the thread updated. :white_check_mark:
